title: Fixed Lattice Mast and Guided Seat Ring Drop Tower
description: One newly authored complete stationary drop-tower-style amusement apparatus exterior. A shared broad grounded plinth carries a full four-chord open square lattice tower with alternating diagonal bracing and four continuous exterior guide rails. One real open-centred thick square carriage ring surrounds the tower in a fixed low pose. Four paired roller sets and complete bearing cheeks meet the corresponding rails; fixed low support shoulders under the ring make the displayed support explicit. Four whole outward-facing seat/back shells are rooted by full radial carriers to this one carriage, with complete fixed curved upper-body bars, and the tower ends in a stepped full cap with four rail stops. This is not a suspended-chair canopy with fewer seats, a grooved weight cassette on a two-rod pulldown portal renamed, or old props combined: all geometry newly authored, counted together as one apparatus and zero scenes. Four opaque PBR roles, metres Z up and whole horizontal-envelope-centred ground datum. Unoccupied static illustrative exterior only; the fixed seat ring is not a simulation of free fall. No passenger fit, operating lift, rope/drive system, travel range, brake, restraint performance, installation, structural load, ride operation, fabrication or safety capability. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
